title: probing-aware-fallback-throttle-and-slo-hysteresis-resolver
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Motivation: In production we observed rapid probe-triggered regional failovers during transient capacity spikes which caused oscillation and tenant impact. Existing SLO enforcement reacted on single probe failures and immediately escalated to full regional fallback. This PR introduces a probing-aware fallback throttle and an SLO hysteresis resolver to smooth decisions, reduce rejoin churn, and provide a short grace window for transient probe failures. Summary of changes: 1) probing-aware fallback throttle: add a probe-backoff state machine that delays promoting a probe failure into a regional failover until a configurable probe window and retry budget are exhausted; 2) SLO hysteresis resolver: compute an adjusted SLO breach score by applying temporal smoothing (EWMA) and tenant-weighted penalties so short blips do not flip circuits; 3) telemetry: emit new metrics (slo_hysteresis_score, probe_backoff_state, probe_backoff_count) and tracing hooks for decision paths; 4) config surface: runtime flags with safe per-region defaults and a feature flag to gate behavior; 5) tests and docs: unit tests for transitions, integration canary harness scenario, ops dashboard and runbook updates. Testing and validation: unit + integration harness covering probe flapping scenarios, local canary with synthetic probe noise showing 4x reduction in false failovers, load test with 10% of traffic showed latency SLOs maintained. Rollout plan: feature-flagged off by default; staged canary: 5% traffic for 48h, then 25% for 24h, then full rollout if metrics stable. Monitoring: new dashboard tile and alerts for slo_hysteresis_score > 0.8 for >10m and probe_backoff_state == "stalled" for >5m. Rollback plan: flip feature flag off; if immediate revert required, also reapply config snapshot from release. Related work: ENG-1842, incident SUP-4218. Impact: expected to reduce regional rejoin churn and unnecessary capacity shuffling at the cost of a small additional delay (configurable) before hard failover. Configuration defaults chosen conservatively for safety. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration scenario [x] telemetry and dashboards [x] docs/runbook updated [x] feature flag present [x] post-deploy verification steps documented.
